Dear [Miss Grigg](../persons.html#586),
I send a few papers with many thanks to you for dispersing them. [Miss Adams](../persons.html#15) and [her aunt](../persons.html#1870) are arriving today, and in all the troubles of getting into their house this afternoon.

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
